change_summary: Fixed country-picker result ordering and failed-request recovery. Picker calls now send a bounded requestId that the country tool echoes; the UI applies only the matching promise, ignores all picker-originated initial notifications, and still accepts fresh chat-originated initial results. Failed or malformed picker responses restore the retained country selector and usable Retry control after an old pending Retry is canceled. Bumped the discovery resource URI to invalidate the prior UI cache.
decisions: Use an echoed requestId to distinguish app picker results from chat-originated country tool results without suppressing legitimate same-country chat results.
A fresh chat-originated result supersedes an in-flight picker request; later picker promise settlement or notification cannot replace it.
A failed picker leaves the retained catalog and audio intact, restores its country in the select, and refreshes More/Retry state once the request settles.
